evidence: Path and specificity features did not improve the degree-matched model
observation: On degree-matched negatives, PPR-only scored 0.255146/0.246866 and base+PPR 0.273148/0.284736 against base 0.289355/0.286595. Family/TDL features gave 0.289381/0.275746 and weighted ligand/GO features 0.289395/0.285079; F-0037 drops them and switches to a bipartite IDF SVD.
subject: F-44
title: PPR and hand-built specificity features fail
